product: Assisted table and simple numeric drafting, not a general interpreter

in_scope_low_burden.denominator: All author-labelled in-scope held-out obligations, including missing-context/catalogue cases

source_wrong_reviewed_approvable.reviewer: assistant author, explicitly no independent review

grading: Report raw counts plus 0/1/2+/rewrite/context; compare whole source meaning, not expression strings. Refused drafts do not count as correct interpretations.
freeze: Commit source, vocabularies, prompts and evaluator before opening fourth source/labels. Record hash in output. Run once; no tuning or repair rerun after seeing output.
effort: Do not substitute assistant estimates or automated actions for teammate-observed edit/time sessions.
